$comment: Single source of truth for repos that require a PR workflow to master. Consumed by hooks/protect-branches.ts (blocks Claude from pushing to master) and scripts/github-config.sh (applies the FULL require-PR ruleset; everything else gets the LITE ruleset). IuRoot repos are PR-required by path and handled separately in the hook. Add a repo here to enforce PRs in both layers at once. Symlinked to ~/.claude/pr-required-repos.json by `make setup`.
